scope: v3 scripts (trycurio.app formula, Zack voice) for P1-P6

voice.evidence: observed_first_party: the account's ElevenLabs history shows Zack on about 980 generations from 2026-07-09 to 2026-10-12, including the trycurio.app reel scripts (jet suit, jet-engine fire tank, exploding whale, upside-down car)

new_claims.claim: Steffen order seats people back to front, window seats first, alternating rows
Putting your own mask on first follows from having under a minute of useful consciousness
new_claims.basis: C-TUC-03/04 plus the standard airline safety instruction to secure your own mask before helping others

new_claims.claim: 688 m is nearly half a mile
6:54 is 'nearly seven minutes'; 3:36 is 'about three and a half'
new_claims.basis: rounding of C-BRD-02 and C-BRD-05; the exact times are on screen

P2-miners.voiceover_tagged: [tense] These thirty-three miners were trapped nearly half a mile underground, with food for two or three days. [curious] Drills kept punching holes to find them. On day seventeen, one broke through. [surprised] When the drill came back up, a note was taped to it. All thirty-three were alive.
